BiblicalUsage: Zophar is one of the three friends of Job who came to comfort him. In Job 2:11, Zophar the Naamathite. The fuller story is told on the Zophar profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zophar belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
